notes: Exhaustive collection of Arkansas animal shelters, humane societies, rescue organizations, wildlife rehabilitators, horse rescues, and spay/neuter services. Major organizations include Humane Society of Pulaski County (Arkansas' only 4-star rated since 1946), Best Friends Pet Resource Center (first-of-its-kind facility in Bentonville), Kitties and Kanines (7,000 spay/neuters yearly since 2009), and Northeast Arkansas Humane Society (since 1971). Over half of Arkansas shelters have achieved no-kill status. Coverage spans Little Rock metro, Northwest Arkansas (Fayetteville, Rogers, Bentonville, Springdale), Fort Smith, Jonesboro, Hot Springs, Mountain Home, Texarkana, and rural areas statewide.
